title: Chachu #4
desc: IMAN VELLANI & MARIANNA IGNAZZI's smash hit crime caper continues! As Cleo attempts a daring escape from her captors, Leila and Chachu deal with an even more nefarious foe: the Vegas hangover. But Cyril's henchmen have taken notice of their investigation about town, and a headache is about to be the least of their worries...
